job.title: Backend Engineer (Node.js)
job.description:
Parcelstream is hiring a Backend Engineer to build the APIs behind our shipping platform.

You will:
- Design and build REST and GraphQL APIs in Node.js and TypeScript
- Model data in PostgreSQL and write performant queries
- Build event-driven services with queues (SQS, Kafka)
- Write integration tests and own services in production
- Deploy with Docker on AWS (ECS, Lambda)
- Participate in code review and on-call

You have:
- 3+ years of backend development
- Strong Node.js and TypeScript
- SQL and PostgreSQL experience
- Experience with Docker and AWS
- Understanding of security best practices and authentication (OAuth, JWT)
- Testing discipline (Jest, integration tests)

professionalSummary.summary: Smart contract developer with 2 years of Solidity experience and a full-stack JavaScript background.

achievements: Wrote and audited Solidity contracts for an ERC-20 staking protocol holding $4M in deposits
Built a Node.js and TypeScript indexer that reads contract events into PostgreSQL
Exposed indexed data through a REST API used by the web app
Wrote Foundry and Hardhat test suites, reaching full branch coverage on core contracts
Containerized the indexer with Docker and deployed it on AWS ECS
Built Express endpoints and React pages for a scheduling SaaS
Added JWT-based authentication and role checks to the API
Wrote Jest unit tests for billing logic
